picks.rationale: Highest actionability in the pool — FL Studio 2026's Gopher AI now performs real actions inside a project (routing, levels, plugin params, Piano Roll generation), directly changing how producers work.
picks.excerpt: FL Studio 2026 expands its Gopher AI assistant so it can now perform actions inside a project — organising tracks, routing mixer channels, setting levels, adjusting plugin parameters and generating Piano Roll content.

picks.rationale: A concrete new monetization path — LANDR's $1M advance initiative lets independent musicians take upfront payments for licensing catalogues to AI companies while staying eligible for recurring revenue.
picks.excerpt: LANDR unveiled the next phase of its Fair Trade AI programme — a $1 million advance initiative letting independent musicians take upfront payments for licensing their catalogues to AI companies while staying eligible for recurring licensing revenue.

picks.rationale: Free tool putting an LLM directly inside drum synthesis — Sugar Bytes' DrumComputer Claude Extension generates full drum sounds and beats from a single text prompt, an immediately usable workflow.
picks.excerpt: Sugar Bytes released a free DrumComputer Claude Extension that generates complete DrumComputer drum sounds and beats from a single natural-language text prompt, bringing an LLM directly into drum synthesis.

picks.rationale: Hands-on review with honest limits — Klang.io Transcription Studio turns audio into notation, lead sheets and guitar tabs, helping musicians judge where AI transcription fits their workflow today.
picks.excerpt: Hands-on review of Klang.io Transcription Studio, an AI tool that turns audio into notated transcriptions, lead sheets and guitar tabs — strong at single-instrument pitch detection but still an editing aid rather than a replacement for human transcribers.

picks.rationale: A free, usable tracker plugin and a vivid case of AI lowering the barrier — a lifelong tracker user with no dev background built WiseTracker with Claude over several hundred hours.
picks.excerpt: WiseTracker is a free FastTracker 2-style tracker plugin and standalone app built by a lifelong tracker user who isn't a traditional developer — he used Claude to code it over several hundred hours, another example of AI lowering the barrier to building music tools.
